text.tspan: People using at least a basic drinking water source
Basic access to drinking water is defined as an improved drinking water source, provided collection time is not
more than 30 minutes for a roundtrip including queuing.
Data source: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation and Hygiene (2025)
